mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.status AS resource_status, v.name, v.description, v.status AS version_status, (om.status = 'active' AND ou.status = 'active') AS owner_active, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.businessRole')) AS business_role, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.icon')) AS icon, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.color')) AS color, JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.publicExamples') AS examples, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.welcomeMessage')) AS welcome_message, JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.suggestedQuestions') AS suggested_questions, JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.skillVersionIds') AS skill_versions, (JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.attachmentsEnabled') = TRUE) AS attachments_enabled, (JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.agentType')) = 'workflow' OR (mp.enabled = TRUE AND provider.enabled = TRUE)) AS model_available, h.id AS hire_id, h.revision AS hire_revision, a.id AS application_id, a.revision AS application_revision, CASE WHEN h.status IN ('active','paused') THEN h.status WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE COALESCE(h.status, 'none') END AS hire_status, l.listed, (l.hire_policy = 'approval') AS requires_approval,

FROM resource r JOIN resource_version v ON v.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND v.resource_id = r.id AND v.id = r.published_version_id JOIN enterprise_member om ON om.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND om.user_id = r.owner_user_id JOIN app_user ou ON ou.id = om.user_id LEFT JOIN agent_listing l ON l.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND l.agent_id = r.id LEFT JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.enterprise_id = v.enterprise_id AND mp.id = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.modelProfileId')) LEFT JOIN model_provider provider ON provider.enterprise_id = mp.enterprise_id AND provider.id = mp.provider_id LEFT JOIN agent_hire h ON h.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND h.agent_id = r.id AND h.user_id = #{user} LEFT JOIN agent_hire_request a ON a.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND a.agent_id = r.id AND a.user_id = #{user} AND a.pending_marker = 1 AND a.expires_at > #{now}
CASE WHEN h.status IN ('active','paused') THEN COALESCE(h.last_used_at, h.hired_at) WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN a.created_at ELSE h.hired_at END
mapper.select:

(h.id IS NOT NULL OR a.id IS NOT NULL) (
AND l.listed = TRUE AND v.status = 'available')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resource_tag rt JOIN tag t ON t.enterprise_id = rt.enterprise_id AND t.id = rt.tag_id WHERE rt.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND rt.resource_id = r.id AND rt.tag_id = #{tag} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL)
AND ( < #{cursor.time} OR (
= #{cursor.time} AND r.id < #{cursor.id}))
ORDER BY position_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

AND l.listed = TRUE AND v.status = 'available'))
